Each of the five stores carries at least one of four distinct types of music: folk, jazz, opera, and rock. None of the stores carries any other type of music. The following conditions must hold: Exactly two of the five stores carry jazz. T carries rock and opera but no other type of music. S carries more types of music than T carries. X carries more types of music than any other store in Crescentville carries. Jazz is among the types of music S carries. V does not carry any type of music that Z carries.
# Question:
If V is one of exactly three stores that carry rock, then which one of the following must be true?
# Options:
A) S and Z carry no types of music in common.
B) S and V carry at least one type of music in common.
C) S and Z carry at least one type of music in common.
D) T and Z carry at least one type of music in common.
E) T and V carry at least two types of music in common.

C

stores = [S, T, V, X, Z]
music_types = [folk, jazz, opera, rock]
carries = Function('carries', stores_sort, music_sort, BoolSort())

# Constraints
pre_conditions = []
# CONSTRAINT: Each of the five stores carries at least one of four distinct types of music
s = Const('s', stores_sort)
pre_conditions.append(ForAll([s], Sum([carries(s, m) for m in music_types]) >= 1))
# CONSTRAINT: Exactly two of the five stores carry jazz
pre_conditions.append(Sum([carries(s, jazz) for s in stores]) == 2)
# CONSTRAINT: T carries rock and opera but no other type of music
pre_conditions.append(And(carries(T, rock), carries(T, opera), Not(carries(T, folk)), Not(carries(T, jazz))))
# CONSTRAINT: S carries more types of music than T carries
pre_conditions.append(Sum([carries(S, m) for m in music_types]) > Sum([carries(T, m) for m in music_types]))
# CONSTRAINT: X carries more types of music than any other store in Crescentville carries
s = Const('s', stores_sort)
pre_conditions.append(ForAll([s], Implies(s != X, Sum([carries(X, m) for m in music_types]) > Sum([carries(s, m) for m in music_types]))))
# CONSTRAINT: Jazz is among the types of music S carries
pre_conditions.append(carries(S, jazz))
# CONSTRAINT: V does not carry any type of music that Z carries
m = Const('m', music_sort)
pre_conditions.append(ForAll([m], Implies(carries(Z, m), Not(carries(V, m)))))
# Additional constraint: V is one of exactly three stores that carry rock
pre_conditions.append(And(carries(V, rock), Sum([carries(s, rock) for s in stores]) == 3))

# Question: If V is one of exactly three stores that carry rock, then which one of the following must be true?
def is_valid(option_constraints):
    solver = Solver()
    solver.add(pre_conditions)
    solver.add(Not(option_constraints))
    return solver.check() == unsat

# OPTION A) S and Z carry no types of music in common
m = Const('m', music_sort)
if is_valid(ForAll([m], Not(And(carries(S, m), carries(Z, m))))): print('A')
# OPTION B) S and V carry at least one type of music in common
m = Const('m', music_sort)
if is_valid(Exists([m], And(carries(S, m), carries(V, m)))): print('B')
# OPTION C) S and Z carry at least one type of music in common
m = Const('m', music_sort)
if is_valid(Exists([m], And(carries(S, m), carries(Z, m)))): print('C')
# OPTION D) T and Z carry at least one type of music in common

# OPTION E) T and V carry at least two types of music in common

If K is on a committee, J must also be on that committee. M must be on at least one of the committees. The two committees must have at least one member in common.
# Question:
The largest number of members that the planting committee and the trails committee could have in common is
# Options:
A) three
B) four
C) five

volunteers = [F, G, H, J, K, L, M]
on_planting = Function('on_planting', volunteers_sort, BoolSort())
on_trails = Function('on_trails', volunteers_sort, BoolSort())

# Constraints
pre_conditions = []
# CONSTRAINT: Each committee must have at least three members.
pre_conditions.append(Sum([on_planting(v) for v in volunteers]) >= 3)
pre_conditions.append(Sum([on_trails(v) for v in volunteers]) >= 3)
# CONSTRAINT: F cannot be on the same committee as K.

pre_conditions.append(Not(And(on_trails(F), on_trails(K))))
# CONSTRAINT: If K is on a committee, J must also be on that committee.
pre_conditions.append(Implies(on_planting(K), on_planting(J)))
pre_conditions.append(Implies(on_trails(K), on_trails(J)))
# CONSTRAINT: M must be on at least one of the committees.
pre_conditions.append(Or(on_planting(M), on_trails(M)))
# CONSTRAINT: The two committees must have at least one member in common.
pre_conditions.append(Sum([And(on_planting(v), on_trails(v)) for v in volunteers]) >= 1)

def max_common():

    solver.add(pre_conditions)
    common_count = Int('common_count')

    return max_val
